intro: In the Wetlands, Rethiel the Greenwarden asks you to draw Carnage from its lair. The Razormaw alpha's plague driven frenzy has thrown the marshes out of balance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The natural order of this land is breaking. Once it was that the Razormaw raptors kept the land from overgrowth. They now live in fear of their alpha, named only for the carnage it leaves behind.
I fear the beast has been driven mad by the sickness that we have yet to fully excise.
It will respond to the malignant flesh of the diseased bears below Raptor Ridge, to the northeast. Leave their entrails in its cave lair.
Carnage will come. Bring me its head.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Rotclaw came down from their homes in Loch Modan, now driven mad.
Such a waste of life's boon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Carnage's death will bring balance to his pack. Perhaps it will buy enough time for the greater ecosystem they support.
We shall see, but I thank you for the effort regardless.
